marcasPage.heroSubtitle: The full catalog organized by manufacturer and model: farm machinery, construction equipment and professional tools. Each model shows which subcategories it fits.
marcasPage.ctaSubtitle: Filter the catalog by subcategory, brand and model, or list your machinery for free in under 5 minutes.

desc.tractores: Farm tractors of every range: compact utility units and 200+ HP heavy tractors. Check the power (CV), hours of use and whether it has a 3-point hitch and PTO.
desc.cosechadoras: Grass and forage harvesters: cutting width, year and hours of use make the difference. Compare power, cutterbar condition and maintenance before closing the deal.
desc.maquinaria-agricola: Implements and auxiliary farm equipment: seeders, ploughs, mowers, milking machines and precision gear. Check the coupling (3-point, bar or drawbar) and each unit’s condition.
desc.ganaderia: Livestock machinery: milking machines, milk coolers, feed mixers and animal-welfare gear. Hours of use and upkeep show in how clean each unit is kept.
desc.excavadoras: Tracked and wheeled excavators, 1.5 to 40 tonnes: hours of use, undercarriage or tyre condition and paperwork in order. The most in-demand segment on site.
desc.cargadoras: Front and articulated loaders for material and earthmoving: load capacity, tyres and hours of use tell you how much life is left in it.
desc.compactacion: Compactors, rollers and vibrators for base courses and fill: smooth, padfoot and plate. Check the drum, the hydraulic system and the working hours.
desc.plataformas: Aerial platforms, scissor lifts and towers for work at height: reach, working height and diesel or electric power. Ask for the maintenance history.
desc.herramienta-electrica: Professional corded and cordless power tools: drills, grinders, saws and precision tools from brands like Makita, Bosch or DeWalt. Check the voltage and whether a battery is included.
desc.motores: Engines and generators: diesel, petrol and inverter units, from portable sets to three-phase machines. Power (W), voltage and hours of use are what matter.
desc.sierra-poda: Chainsaws, pruning shears and blowers for gardening and maintenance: chain, bar and power for the job at hand. Check the clutch and filter condition.
desc.taller-manual: Manual workshop tools: spanners, sockets, hex and impact tools, jacks and compressors. Professional brands like Bahco, Knipex or Wera, built to last.

marcasPage.guideTitle: How to choose your machinery brand
marcasPage.guideP1: There is no universally «best» brand: the choice depends on the subcategory (a farm tractor is not a 20-tonne excavator or a chainsaw), how you will use it and how close parts and workshops are to you. MaquinariaOcasión organises models by manufacturer and shows real market prices — median and P25–P75 range from our own inventory — so you compare with data, not feelings.
marcasPage.guideP2: Quick rule: within a subcategory, the brand makes the difference in parts, workshop network and resale value; always compare like-for-like. Click «View market prices» on any model to see its real-price page, and filter by condition and hours of use before buying.

about.title: About MaquinariaOcasión
about.subtitle: The marketplace built for Spain.
about.whoP1: MaquinariaOcasión is a marketplace designed specifically for Spain. It was born from the need for a platform where buying and selling used machinery or tools is easy, direct and hassle-free. We believe the machinery market deserves modern tools without intermediaries charging abusive commissions.
about.whoP2: Our team understands commerce in Spain firsthand. We know what it means to sell something you no longer use, find the product you need at a good price, and avoid the 10-15% commissions other platforms charge. That's why we created MaquinariaOcasión: so the price you set is the price you receive.
about.missionP1: Facilitate commerce among Spainns. We want anyone to be able to post what they sell and find buyers in their city quickly, safely and without hidden costs. No middlemen, no sales commissions, no fine print.
about.missionP2: Everyone should be able to sell their machinery or find the one they need, without barriers. Whether it’s an excavator in Madrid, a tractor in Lleida or a chainsaw in Valencia — MaquinariaOcasión connects sellers with buyers.
about.why1_desc: The price you set is the price you receive. We don't touch your money.
about.why2_desc: Internal chat + WhatsApp so you can arrange everything without leaving the platform.
about.why3_desc: From Galicia to Almería, your ad reaches all of Spain.
about.why4_desc: Listing is free. Optional credits only to boost visibility.
about.ctaDesc: Join thousands of Spainns already buying and selling on MaquinariaOcasión.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We answer your questions about buying, selling, and featuring your listings on MaquinariaOcasión
faq.q1: Is it safe to use MaquinariaOcasión?
faq.a1: MaquinariaOcasión connects buyers and sellers directly. We always recommend meeting in public places, verifying the product before paying, and being wary of prices that are too low. Never send money in advance.
faq.a2: No, you need to create an account to post. Registration is free and takes less than a minute.
faq.q3: How many listings can I have?
faq.a3: No limit. You can post as many products as you want, always free.
faq.a4: Credits are an optional internal currency to feature your listings. With credits you can make your product appear first in searches and on the homepage.
faq.q5: What payment methods do you accept for credits?
faq.a5: Bizum, bank transfer and PayPal. We're adding more methods progressively.
faq.q6: Does MaquinariaOcasión handle payments or shipping?
faq.a6: No. MaquinariaOcasión is a platform connecting buyers and sellers. Payment and delivery are arranged directly between the parties.
faq.q7: How do I report a fraudulent listing?
faq.a7: Every listing has a "Report" button. You can also write to us at soporte@maquinariaocasion.online with the details.
faq.q9: How do I contact a seller?
faq.a9: Each listing has a direct message button, WhatsApp and phone (if the seller enabled it). You can also use MaquinariaOcasión's built-in chat.
faq.q10: Can I sell other vehicles on MaquinariaOcasión?
faq.a10: No. MaquinariaOcasión is a vertical marketplace specialised exclusively in second-hand machinery and tools: farm, construction and professional tools.
faq.q11: Is it free to post on MaquinariaOcasión?
faq.a11: Yes, posting is 100% free. Credits are optional and only serve to feature your listing and reach more buyers.
faq.noAnswerDesc: Write to us and we'll help you

howItWorks.heroSubtitle: Buy and sell in Spain in 4 simple steps. List for free and start receiving messages today.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create your account, upload photos of your machinery, set a price in € and describe what you’re selling. No commissions, no fine print. Listing is 100% free.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Your ad appears on the homepage, catalogue and searches across Spain. Real buyers looking for what you offer, directly in your province.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Buyers contact you via internal chat, WhatsApp or phone (if you enable it). No intermediaries, no commissions. You decide the price and payment method.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Verified profiles, ad moderation and reputation system. Buy and sell with confidence. If something is wrong, report it.
howItWorks.faq1a: Yes. Every seller gets 1 free credit to post their first listing. If you want to feature your listing for more visibility, you can buy additional credits.
howItWorks.faq2a: Credits are purchased in the "Credits" section. We accept Bizum, bank transfer and PayPal. It's always cheaper in bulk.
howItWorks.faq3a: You arrange payment directly with the buyer. MaquinariaOcasión does not handle payments. Accept bank transfer, Bizum, cash or whatever suits you best.
howItWorks.faq4a: No. We don't charge commission on sales. Your ad is visible and the price you set is the price you get.
howItWorks.faq5a: Click "Sign up" in the header. You can use your email or Google account. It's fast and free. Your account is active in under a minute.
howItWorks.faq6q: What can I sell on MaquinariaOcasión?
howItWorks.faq6a: MaquinariaOcasión is machinery-vertical only: second-hand machinery and tools — farm, construction and professional tools. No cars, bikes, real estate or other categories.

installApp.title: Install the MaquinariaOcasión App
installApp.subtitle: You don't need to search any app store. MaquinariaOcasión is a progressive web app (PWA) that installs directly from your browser. In 3 steps!
installApp.androidReq: Requirement: Use Google Chrome on your Android
installApp.androidStep1Title: Open Chrome and go to maquinariaocasion.online
installApp.androidStep1Desc: Make sure you're on the correct URL. If you already have the page open, great.
installApp.androidStep2Title: Tap the 3-dot menu (⋮) at the top right
installApp.androidStep3Title: Find and tap "Install app" or "Add to home screen"
installApp.androidStep3Desc: Depending on your Chrome version, you'll see one of these options. A banner at the bottom may also say "Install MaquinariaOcasión".
installApp.androidStep4Desc: A confirmation dialog will appear. Tap "Install". Done! You now have MaquinariaOcasión as an app on your home screen.
installApp.iosReq: Requirement: Use Safari on your iPhone
installApp.iosStep1Title: Open Safari and go to maquinariaocasion.online
installApp.iosStep1Desc: ⚠️ Important: Doesn't work with Chrome, Firefox or other browsers on iPhone. Only Safari allows app installation.
installApp.iosStep2Desc: It's in the Safari bar at the bottom of the screen (on iPhones with Face ID it's at the top in the bar).
installApp.iosStep3Title: Scroll down until you see "Add to Home Screen"
installApp.iosStep3Desc: It's a bit further down in the share menu. If you don't see it, scroll more.
installApp.iosStep4Desc: You can change the name if you want. Then tap "Add" in the top right corner. Done!
installApp.why1desc: An icon on your home screen. Open with one tap, no bookmark searching.
installApp.why2desc: Loads without the browser bar. Experience similar to a native app.
installApp.why3desc: Get alerts for messages and new listings without opening the app.
installApp.why4desc: You can view the last page you visited even without connection.
